name: ImmunizationForecast
title: Immunization Forecast
description: Produces immunization forecast output from patient demographics, immunizations, observations, and a selected forecasting module. Output includes ImmunizationRecommendation and ImmunizationEvaluation resources with ICE-specific extensions for series selection type and season.

parameter.name: assessmentDate
parameter.documentation: The date on which the immunization forecast should be assessed.

parameter.name: module
parameter.documentation: The forecasting module to execute, expressed as a canonical PlanDefinition identifier and version.

parameter.name: immunization
parameter.documentation: Immunization resources to be considered in the forecast.

parameter.name: parameters
parameter.documentation: Optional implementation-specific tuning or execution parameters.

parameter.name: guidanceResponse
parameter.documentation: Summary metadata describing the execution and outcome of the forecast.

parameter.name: assessmentDate
parameter.documentation: The effective assessment date actually used by the forecasting service.

parameter.name: engineVersion
parameter.documentation: The CDS engine version that processed the request.

parameter.name: evaluation
parameter.documentation: ImmunizationEvaluation resources produced by the forecast. extension may include url http://terminology.cdsframework.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/immunization-selection-context with nested extensions selectedSeries, seriesSelectionType, and selectedSeason. targetDisease is represented as a single CodeableConcept and may contain multiple codings for component/multi-disease vaccines.

parameter.name: recommendation
parameter.documentation: ImmunizationRecommendation resources produced by the forecast. recommendation.extension may include url http://terminology.cdsframework.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/immunization-selection-context with nested extensions selectedSeries, seriesSelectionType, and selectedSeason.

parameter.name: operationOutcome
parameter.documentation: Warnings, informational notes, or errors related to processing.
